title: Recursive Polynomial Model Estimator
text: Estimate input-output and time-series polynomial model coefficients, 8 inputs, 3 outputs, {External reset} sets trigger for external reset; {Initial Estimate} sets the source of initial parameter estimates, {Number of Parameters in A(q) (na)} sets the number of estimated parameters, {Number of Parameters in B(q) (nb)} sets the number of estimated parameters in the B, {Number of Parameters in C(q) (nc)} sets the number of estimated parameters in the C, {Number of Parameters in D(q) (nd)} sets the number of estimated parameters in the D, {Number of Parameters in F(q) (nf)} sets the number of estimated parameters in the F, {Input Delay (nk)} sets the input delay, {Parameter Covariance Matrix} sets the initial parameter covariance 1e4, {Initial A(q)} sets the initial values, {Initial B(q)} sets the initial values of the B, {Initial C(q)} sets the initial values of the C, {Initial D(q)} sets the initial values of the D, {Initial F(q)} sets the initial values of the F, {Initial Inputs} sets the initial values of the inputs buffer, {Initial Outputs} sets the initial values of the measured outputs, {Input Processing} sets the sample-based or frame-based processing, {Sample Time} sets the block sample time, {History} sets the infinite or finite data, {Window Length} sets the window size for finite sliding-window, {Estimation Method} sets the recursive estimation algorithm Forgetting, {Forgetting Factor} sets the discount old data using forgetting factor, {Process Noise Covariance} sets the process noise covariance for Kalman filter estimation, {Adaptation Gain} sets the adaptation gain specification for gradient estimation, {Normalization Bias} sets the bias for adaptation gain scaling for normalized gradient estimation method, {Output estimation error} adds Error outport to block, {Output parameter covariance matrix} adds covariance outport to block and {Add enable port} adds Enable inport to block. Values come from the instance.
